options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: auth_providers
options.description: Specifies the auth providers which need to be added or removed from access zone. If I(auth_providers) are given, then I(provider_state) should also be specified.

options.name: az_name
options.description: The name of the access zone.

options.name: create_path
options.description: Determines if a path is created when a path does not exist.

options.name: groupnet
options.description: Name of the groupnet for create access zone.

options.name: nfs
options.description: Specifies the default NFS setting parameters of access zone.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: path
options.description: Specifies the access zone base directory path.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: provider_state
options.description: Defines whether the auth providers should be added or removed from access zone. If I(auth_providers) are given, then I(provider_state) should also be specified. C(add) - indicates that the auth providers should be added to the access zone. C(remove) - indicates that auth providers should be removed from the access zone.

options.name: smb
options.description: Specifies the default SMB setting parameters of access zone.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the access zone should exist or not. C(present) - indicates that the access zone should exist on the system. C(absent) - indicates that the access zone should not exist on the system.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
